church.whatsappNoteSw: Kundi la WhatsApp la usharika linasimamiwa na ofisi. Omba kiungo kwa mchungaji au karani — si orodha ya simu za waumini.

church.aboutSw: Dayosisi ya KKKT mjini Shinyanga. Kanisa kuu: Usharika wa Ebenezer. Pia: Angaza (Chamaguha) na Makedonia (Lubaga). Programu hii ni mwenza wa waumini: tangazo, ibada, nyimbo, mahubiri ya YouTube, ramani ya jumuiya na usajili. Haiwezi kuchukua nafasi ya WhatsApp wala kuwa ERP ya usharika.
church.aboutEn: A KKKT diocese in Shinyanga. Cathedral: Ebenezer Congregation. Also: Angaza (Chamaguha) and Makedonia (Lubaga). This app is a member companion for notices, worship, hymns, YouTube sermons, jumuiya maps and light registration. It does not replace WhatsApp and is not church ERP.

congregations.noteSw: Usharika mkuu wa KKKT DKMZV mjini Shinyanga.

announcements.bodySw: Ibada ya asubuhi 07:30 na ibada kuu 10:00. Mada: Neema inayotosha. Meza ya Bwana itashirikiwa katika ibada kuu. Njoo na mgeni.
announcements.bodyEn: Early service 07:30 and main service 10:00. Theme: Grace that is enough. Holy Communion at the main service. Bring a guest.

announcements.bodySw: Wanafunzi wa kipaimara wanakutana Jumamosi 26 Septemba, saa 09:00–12:00 katika ukumbi. Lete Biblia na daftari. Wazazi wakaribishwa dakika 15 za mwisho.
announcements.bodyEn: Confirmands meet Saturday 26 September, 09:00–12:00 in the hall. Bring a Bible and notebook. Parents are welcome for the last 15 minutes.

announcements.bodySw: Kwaya kuu inafanya mazoezi Alhamisi 24 Septemba saa 16:30. Tunajiandaa kwa ibada ya shukrani za mavuno. Wanachama wapya wakaribishwa.
announcements.bodyEn: The main choir rehearses Thursday 24 September at 16:30. We are preparing for harvest thanksgiving. New members welcome.

announcements.titleSw: Umoja wa Wanawake — sadaka ya upendo
announcements.bodySw: UW wanakutana Jumamosi 26 Septemba saa 14:00. Mada: huduma kwa wagonjwa wa usharika. Sadaka ndogo ya hiari itasaidia ziara.
announcements.bodyEn: UW meets Saturday 26 September at 14:00. Theme: visiting the sick of the congregation. A small voluntary gift will support visits.

announcements.bodySw: Kikundi cha Neno kinakutana Jumatano 23 Septemba saa 17:00. Tunaanza Waraka kwa Wafilipi. Hakuna ada.
announcements.bodyEn: The Word group meets Wednesday 23 September at 17:00. We begin Philippians. No fee.

announcements.bodySw: Ibada maalum ya shukrani za mavuno Jumapili 11 Oktoba saa 10:00. Lete shukrani (si lazima mazao). Ofisi inapokea orodha ya huduma wiki moja kabla.
announcements.bodyEn: Special harvest thanksgiving on Sunday 11 October at 10:00. Bring a thanksgiving gift (produce optional). The office takes the service roster one week prior.

announcements.titleEn: WhatsApp does not replace the office
announcements.bodySw: Tangazo la haraka linaweza kwenda kundi la WhatsApp. Ombi la kichungaji, cheti au sadaka rasmi — pitia ofisi au fomu ya programu.
announcements.bodyEn: Urgent notices may go to the WhatsApp group. Pastoral requests, certificates or official giving still go through the office or this app’s form.

hymns.titleEn: A mighty fortress is our God
hymns.firstLineSw: Mungu wetu ni ngome yetu, ngome imara milele
hymns.lyricsSw:
Mungu wetu ni ngome yetu,
ngome imara milele.
Yeye ni kinga na nguvu,
tusaidie hatutishwi.

Ijapokuwa adui huja,
Bwana ndiye shinda yetu.
Neno lake linasimama;
Roho wetu unatulia.
hymns.lyricsEn:
A mighty fortress is our God,
a bulwark never failing.
Our helper he amid the flood
of mortal ills prevailing.

The Word above all earthly powers,
no thanks to them, abideth.
The Spirit and the gifts are ours
through him who with us sideth.

hymns.titleEn: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
hymns.firstLineSw: Sifa na utukufu kwa Mungu Mwenyezi
hymns.lyricsSw:
Sifa na utukufu kwa Mungu Mwenyezi,
mfalme wa viumbe, Baba wa huruma.
Njoni, msifu;
ngoma na sauti viniwe pamoja.

Yeye hutulinda mchana na usiku;
neema yake hairudi tupu.
Tumwimbie sasa,
Mungu wa Israeli, Mungu wetu.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty,
the King of creation.
O my soul, praise him,
for he is your health and salvation.

Ponder anew what the Almighty can do,
if with his love he befriend you.

hymns.titleEn: What a friend we have in Jesus
hymns.firstLineSw: Rafiki wa kweli ni Yesu, mtunzaji wa dhiki zetu
hymns.source: J. Scriven / C. Converse — public domain (mbegu)
hymns.lyricsSw:
Rafiki wa kweli ni Yesu,
mtunzaji wa dhiki zetu.
Kwa maombi twamwendea;
hatuhitaji kubeba peke yetu.

Je, tuna majonzi mengi?
Twende kwake tena.
Yeye anasikia kilio
na kutupa amani yake.
hymns.lyricsEn:
What a friend we have in Jesus,
all our sins and griefs to bear.
What a privilege to carry
everything to God in prayer.

Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged:
take it to the Lord in prayer.

hymns.firstLineSw: Kaa nami, ee Bwana, jioni inakaribia
hymns.lyricsSw:
Kaa nami, ee Bwana,
jioni inakaribia.
Giza laisha;
wewe u nuru yetu.

Msaada wa dunia hupita,
wewe habadiliki.
Kaa nami, Rafiki,
hadi asubuhi.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Abide with me, fast falls the eventide.
The darkness deepens; Lord, with me abide.
When other helpers fail and comforts flee,
help of the helpless, O abide with me.

hymns.titleEn: I know that my Redeemer lives
hymns.firstLineSw: Ninajua Mwokozi yu hai, yu hai milele
hymns.lyricsSw:
Ninajua Mwokozi yu hai,
yu hai milele.
Yeye hunena jina langu
mbele za Baba.

Yeye ni fungu langu hai;
kifo hakina neno la mwisho.
Tumsifu Bwana wa Pasaka
Shinyanga na duniani.

hymns.firstLineSw: Njooni, tumwabudu, furaha na imani
hymns.lyricsSw:
Njooni, tumwabudu,
furaha na imani.
Njooni, njooni Betlehemu;
mwone Mwana mfalme.

Ee, tumwimbie,
Mungu katika mwili.
Utukufu kwa Baba
juu mbinguni.
hymns.lyricsEn:
O come, all ye faithful, joyful and triumphant.
O come ye, o come ye to Bethlehem.
Come and behold him, born the King of angels.
O come, let us adore him, Christ the Lord.

hymns.firstLineSw: Furaha kuu duniani, Bwana amefika
hymns.lyricsSw:
Furaha kuu duniani,
Bwana amefika.
Nchi na milima na mito
vipokee Mfalme.

Hatazui dhambi tena
kama zamani.
Neema na kweli zimekutana;
tumwimbie sasa.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Joy to the world, the Lord is come.
Let earth receive her King.
Let every heart prepare him room,
and heaven and nature sing.

hymns.firstLineSw: Utakatifu, utakatifu, Mungu Mwenyezi
hymns.lyricsSw:
Utakatifu, utakatifu, utakatifu,
Mungu Mwenyezi.
Asubuhi na jioni
twakuimbia.

Utakatifu, utakatifu, utakatifu,
Mungu wa Utatu.
Huruma na nguvu na sifa
vyote ni vyako.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty.
Early in the morning our song shall rise to thee.
Holy, holy, holy, merciful and mighty,
God in three persons, blessed Trinity.

hymns.titleEn: Our Father, who art in heaven
hymns.firstLineSw: Baba yetu uliye mbinguni, jina lako litukuzwe
hymns.lyricsSw:
Baba yetu uliye mbinguni,
jina lako litukuzwe.
Ufalme wako ufike,
mapenzi yako yatimizwe
duniani kama mbinguni.

Utupe leo mkate wetu.
Utusamehe deni zetu
kama nasi tuwasamehevyo wadeni.
Usitutie majaribuni,
utuokoe na yule mwovu.
Amina.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Our Father, who art in heaven,
hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done
on earth as it is in heaven.

Give us this day our daily bread.
Forgive us our trespasses
as we forgive those who trespass against us.
Lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from evil. Amen.

hymns.firstLineSw: Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu, uondoaye dhambi za dunia
hymns.lyricsSw:
Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu,
uondoaye dhambi za dunia,
tuhurumie.

Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu,
uondoaye dhambi za dunia,
tupe amani yako.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Lamb of God, you take away
the sin of the world,
have mercy on us.

Lamb of God, you take away
the sin of the world,
grant us your peace.

hymns.firstLineSw: Roho Mtakatifu njoo, uishi mioyoni mwetu
hymns.lyricsSw:
Roho Mtakatifu, njoo,
uishi mioyoni mwetu.
Utupe nuru na nguvu
kusema Neno kwa uaminifu.

Uufunge kanisa moja;
uwasha moto wa upendo.
Tuko Shinyanga, lakini
wewe ni upepo wa dunia yote.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly dove,
with all your quickening powers.
Kindle a flame of sacred love
in these cold hearts of ours.

hymns.firstLineSw: Yesu ni nuru ya ulimwengu, nuru katika giza
hymns.source: Kimapokeo la KKKT / maandishi ya mbegu
hymns.lyricsSw:
Yesu ni nuru ya ulimwengu,
nuru katika giza.
Anatuongoza njiani;
hatuendi peke yetu.

Tuangaze Chamaguha,
nyumba na soko na shule.
Nuru yako isiwekwe chini;
iwekwe juu ya mlima.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Jesus, the light of the world,
shine in our darkness.
Lead us on the road;
we do not walk alone.

Let Chamaguha see your light
in home and market and school.
A lamp is not hidden;
it is set on a hill.

hymns.firstLineSw: Neema ya ajabu, iliyoniponya
hymns.lyricsSw:
Neema ya ajabu,
iliyoniponya.
Nilipotea, sasa nimeonekana;
nilikuwa kipofu, sasa naona.

Neema ilinifundisha kuogopa,
neema ikaondoa hofu.
Saa niliyoamini kwanza,
neema ilikuwa tamu.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Amazing grace, how sweet the sound
that saved a wretch like me.
I once was lost, but now am found;
was blind, but now I see.

'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
and grace my fears relieved.
How precious did that grace appear
the hour I first believed.

hymns.firstLineSw: Twamsifu Mungu Baba, Mwana na Roho Mtakatifu
hymns.lyricsSw:
Twamsifu Mungu Baba,
Mwana na Roho Mtakatifu.
Kama mwanzo, sasa na milele.
Amina.

Utukufu kwa Baba juu,
na duniani amani
kwa watu wa mapenzi mema.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be. Amen.

hymns.firstLineSw: Karibu meza ya Bwana, mkate na kikombe
hymns.source: Mbegu ya liturujia ya KKKT (si kitabu rasmi)
hymns.lyricsSw:
Karibu meza ya Bwana,
mkate na kikombe.
Mwili wake kwa ajili yetu;
damu yake agano jipya.

Sio kwa stahili zetu,
Bali kwa mwaliko wake.
Tule kwa imani;
tuondoke tukiwa wamoja.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Come to the table of the Lord,
bread and cup for the hungry.
His body given for us;
his blood the new covenant.

Not by our merit,
but by his invitation.
Eat in faith;
go out as one people.

hymns.firstLineSw: Asante Bwana kwa neema yako kila asubuhi
hymns.lyricsSw:
Asante Bwana kwa neema yako
kila asubuhi.
Mvua na jua na mkate
vyote ni kipawa.

Tunakuletea shukrani,
si bei ya upendo wako.
Pokea mioyo yetu
pamoja na sadaka.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Thank you, Lord, for grace
each morning new.
Rain and sun and bread
are all your gift.

We bring thanksgiving,
not a price for love.
Receive our hearts
together with the offering.

hymns.firstLineSw: Twendeni kwa imani, njia ina nuru
hymns.lyricsSw:
Twendeni kwa imani,
njia ina nuru.
Kristus anatutangulia;
hatuogopi jangwa.

Shinyanga ni shamba lake.
Tuseme kweli kwa upole.
Imani hutembea;
haikai kanisani tu.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Forward in faith,
the road has light.
Christ goes before us;
we do not fear the wilderness.

Shinyanga is his field.
Speak truth with gentleness.
Faith walks;
it does not stay in the pew alone.

hymns.firstLineSw: Mungu ni pendo, atupendaye hutunzwa naye
hymns.lyricsSw:
Mungu ni pendo;
atupendaye hutunzwa naye.
Tusife hofu,
pendo hukamilisha.

Tupendane sisi kwa sisi,
kama alivyotupenda.
Hili ndilo sheria na manabii
katika nyumba hii.
hymns.lyricsEn:
God is love;
whoever lives in love lives in God.
There is no fear in love;
perfect love drives out fear.

Let us love one another,
as he first loved us.
This is the law and the prophets
in this house.

hymns.firstLineSw: Yesu, tumaini langu, nakuja kwako leo
hymns.lyricsSw:
Yesu, tumaini langu,
nakuja kwako leo.
Mizigo yangu ni mizito;
unibebeshe neno lako.

Sio dhahabu wala sifa,
Bali wewe pekee.
Nikikosa yote,
nikufanane nawe.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Jesus, my hope,
I come to you today.
My loads are heavy;
carry me by your word.

Not gold and not applause,
but you alone.
If I lose all else,
let me still resemble you.

hymns.firstLineSw: Bwana amefufuka, kweli amefufuka
hymns.lyricsSw:
Bwana amefufuka,
kweli amefufuka!
Kifo kimekwisha;
uzima umeanza.

Twaimba asubuhi ya wiki,
kanisa lote pamoja.
Haleluya, Haleluya,
Yesu yu hai.
hymns.lyricsEn:
The Lord is risen,
he is risen indeed.
Death is finished;
life has begun.

We sing on the first day of the week,
the whole church together.
Alleluia, alleluia,
Jesus lives.

hymns.firstLineSw: Ee Mungu twakuomba kwa nchi yetu Tanzania
hymns.lyricsSw:
Ee Mungu, twakuomba
kwa nchi yetu Tanzania.
Utupe amani na mkate,
haki na huruma.

Uwalinde wagonjwa na watoto,
wakulima na walimu.
Shinyanga iwe na maji na tumaini;
kanisa liwe chumvi.
hymns.lyricsEn:
O God, we pray
for our land Tanzania.
Give peace and daily bread,
justice and mercy.

Guard the sick and the children,
farmers and teachers.
Let Shinyanga have water and hope;
let the church be salt.

hymns.titleEn: Sing to the Lord a new song
hymns.firstLineSw: Imbeni kwa Bwana wimbo mpya, kwaya na kanisa
hymns.lyricsSw:
Imbeni kwa Bwana wimbo mpya;
kanisa lote lisifu.
Ngoma, kinanda na sauti
vimpe heshima.

Sio show, ni sadaka.
Mioyo ndiyo ala kuu.
Kwaya iongoze,
si kujificha nyuma ya sauti.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Sing to the Lord a new song;
let the whole church praise.
Drum, keyboard and voice
give him honour.

This is not a show; it is an offering.
The heart is the first instrument.
Let the choir lead,
not hide behind the sound.

hymns.firstLineSw: Watoto njoni kwake Yesu, anawapenda
hymns.lyricsSw:
Watoto, njoni kwake Yesu;
anawapenda.
Mikono yake iko wazi;
kiti kipo mbele.

Mfunzeni Neno kwa wimbo.
Mchezo na sala vina nafasi.
Kanisa ni nyumba yao pia,
si ya watu wazima tu.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Children, come to Jesus;
he loves you.
His arms are open;
there is a seat in front.

Teach the Word with a song.
Play and prayer both belong.
The church is their house too,
not only for adults.

hymns.firstLineSw: Wanawake wa imani, kama Maria na Marta
hymns.source: Mbegu ya UW — si wimbo rasmi wa kitabu
hymns.lyricsSw:
Wanawake wa imani,
kama Maria na Marta.
Neno na huduma pamoja;
si kinyume.

UW si kundi la siri.
Ni sala, ziara na mkate.
Mungu awaimarishe
katika usharika huu.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Women of faith,
like Mary and Martha.
Word and service together;
not opposed.

UW is not a secret club.
It is prayer, visits and bread.
God strengthen you
in this congregation.

hymns.firstLineSw: Vijana wa Kristo, simameni imara
hymns.lyricsSw:
Vijana wa Kristo,
simameni imara.
Sio aibu kuomba;
sio dhaifu kusamehe.

Tumieni simu kwa nuru,
si kwa kuharibu jina.
Kesho ya kanisa
inaanaza leo.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Youth of Christ,
stand firm.
It is not shame to pray;
it is not weakness to forgive.

Use the phone for light,
not to break a name.
The church’s tomorrow
begins today.

hymns.titleEn: I will walk with the Word
hymns.firstLineSw: Nitakwenda na Neno, kipaimara si mwisho
hymns.lyricsSw:
Nitakwenda na Neno;
kipaimara si mwisho.
Ni ndoano ya imani
mbele ya kanisa.

Roho, niongoze.
Nikikosea, nirudishe.
Nitahudumu kwa furaha
katika DKMZV.
hymns.lyricsEn:
I will walk with the Word;
confirmation is not the end.
It is a yes of faith
before the church.

Spirit, lead me.
When I stray, bring me home.
I will serve with joy
in DKMZV.

hymns.firstLineSw: Sadaka yetu ni shukrani, si malipo ya neema
hymns.lyricsSw:
Sadaka yetu ni shukrani,
si malipo ya neema.
Mkononi mna kidogo;
moyo una mengi.

M-Pesa au sarafu,
Bwana anaona nia.
Utupe furaha ya kutoa
bila kelele.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Our offering is thanksgiving,
not a fee for grace.
The hand may hold little;
the heart can hold much.

M-Pesa or coins,
the Lord sees the will.
Give us joy in giving
without a show.

hymns.firstLineSw: Neno lako ni taa ya miguu yangu
hymns.lyricsSw:
Neno lako ni taa
ya miguu yangu,
na mwanga wa njia yangu.

Sitasahau sheria yako.
Nitaifanya iwe wimbo
nyumbani na kanisani.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Your word is a lamp
to my feet
and a light to my path.

I will not forget your teaching.
I will make it a song
at home and in church.

hymns.firstLineSw: Amani ya Kristo ikae mioyoni mwenu
hymns.lyricsSw:
Amani ya Kristo ikae
mioyoni mwenu.
Msitane njiani;
sameheaneni.

Amani si ukimya wa soko.
Ni Yesu katikati.
Twende nyumbani tukiwa wamoja.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Let the peace of Christ
remain in your hearts.
Do not quarrel on the road;
forgive one another.

Peace is not the silence of the market.
It is Jesus in the midst.
Go home as one people.

hymns.firstLineSw: Twakwenda na baraka, tumetumwa duniani
hymns.lyricsSw:
Twakwenda na baraka;
tumetumwa duniani.
Neno tulilosikia
liwe mkate wa jirani.

Bwana atubariki na kutulinda;
uso wake uangaze.
Amani mpaka tukutane tena.
hymns.lyricsEn:
We go with the blessing;
we are sent into the world.
The Word we heard
becomes bread for the neighbour.

The Lord bless and keep us;
his face shine upon us.
Peace until we meet again.

hymns.firstLineSw: Msalaba wa Yesu ni fahari yetu
hymns.lyricsSw:
Msalaba wa Yesu
ni fahari yetu.
Sio aibu, ni upendo
ulioenda mpaka mwisho.

Tuchukue msalaba wetu,
si wa wengine.
Katika mateso madogo
tukumbuke wake mkuu.
hymns.lyricsEn:
The cross of Jesus
is our boast.
Not shame, but love
that went to the end.

Let us take up our cross,
not another’s.
In small sufferings
remember his great one.

hymns.firstLineSw: Maji ya uzima yanatiririka katika ubatizo
hymns.lyricsSw:
Maji ya uzima
yanatiririka katika ubatizo.
Jina la Baba, Mwana na Roho
linawekwa juu yetu.

Mtoto au mtu mzima,
ni mlango ule ule.
Kanisa, kumbuka ahadi yako:
ilea katika Neno.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Water of life
flows in baptism.
The name of Father, Son and Spirit
is placed upon us.

Infant or adult,
the door is the same.
Church, remember your promise:
raise them in the Word.

hymns.firstLineSw: Familia ya kanisa si damu, ni maji na Neno
hymns.lyricsSw:
Familia ya kanisa
si damu, ni maji na Neno.
Wageni wanakuwa ndugu;
ndugu wanakumbuka wageni.

Usharika wa Angaza,
tuwe nyumba salama.
Bila orodha ya siri,
na bila kusahau jina.
hymns.lyricsEn:
The church family
is not blood, but water and Word.
Strangers become kin;
kin remember the stranger.

Angaza congregation,
be a safe house.
No secret lists,
and no forgotten name.

hymns.firstLineSw: Shukrani za mavuno, Mungu wa mvua na jua
hymns.lyricsSw:
Shukrani za mavuno,
Mungu wa mvua na jua.
Pamba, mahindi na muwa
vyote vina mikono yake.

Tusisahau mjane
na aliye na njaa.
Mavuno ni ya kushiriki,
si ya kujisifia.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Harvest thanksgiving,
God of rain and sun.
Cotton, maize and cane
all bear his hands.

Do not forget the widow
and the hungry.
Harvest is for sharing,
not for boasting.

hymns.firstLineSw: Mchungaji mwema huacha tisini na tisa
hymns.lyricsSw:
Mchungaji mwema
huacha tisini na tisa
kwenda kumtafuta mmoja.

Yesu anatuita kwa jina.
Ofisi haiwezi kumchukua nafasi,
lakini tunaweza kufungua mlango.
Njoo, umeonekana.
hymns.lyricsEn:
The good shepherd
leaves the ninety-nine
to seek the one.

Jesus calls us by name.
The office cannot replace him,
but we can open a door.
Come, you are seen.

hymns.firstLineSw: Tunakwenda kwa amani, tumtumikie Bwana
hymns.lyricsSw:
Tunakwenda kwa amani;
tumtumikie Bwana.
Furaha ya Neno iende
nyumbani na sokoni.

Amina, Amina.
Kristus yu pamoja nasi
hadi tukutane Jumapili ijayo.
hymns.lyricsEn:
Go in peace;
serve the Lord.
Let the joy of the Word travel
home and to the market.

Amen, amen.
Christ is with us
until we meet next Sunday.
